prompt: A charming and whimsical low-poly 3D scene in the style of early PlayStation 1 graphics. In the center of deep space, a giant mirrorball-shaped planet slowly rotates, reflecting blocky multicolored light beams across a dark cosmic background filled with stars. Beneath it, a group of tiny aliens and astronauts--each with 2-head-tall, chibi-like proportions--are dancing joyfully on a floating platform or in zero gravity. The aliens have cube-like or rounded bodies with large polygonal eyes and simple bold colors. The astronauts wear chunky, low-polygon space suits with bubble helmets and short limbs. All characters are unique in color and shape, outlined subtly with dark edges to emphasize form. Their movements are playful and exaggerated, frozen mid-dance with limbs raised or turned, like retro 3D toys brought to life. The overall tone is festive, cute, and nostalgic, evoking the low-resolution magic of early 3D sci-fi games.
